message:
release: 0.2.127 -- the host recovery work gets a number of its own

One line changes: the version literal. Everything this release carries is already in
6b119af, which merged the host thread recovery safeguards with main at 437c87c and was
reviewed independently before this bump -- nine areas along their real call paths, a
clean build from the root, Native 12 of 13 and the server suite green.

This commit, not 6b119af, is the release source. The distinction matters because the
binaries are built from here.

The build that follows has to be a new directory. 0.2.126 published a Stream binary
stamped 0.2.125: an incremental build reused a stale object, the hash matched, the
signature verified, and the verifier had nothing to object to, because none of those
things read the version out of the payload. A build from the root into a fresh tree did
not reproduce it. So the version string in each artifact gets grepped out of the bytes
this time rather than inferred from the source that was supposed to produce them.

Not done here: signing, the manifest, and publishing. This is the build-and-package step
only, and nothing has been fetched over https or compared against what the server serves.
